history.content: ok so this app is supposed to help me 'process my feelings' lol. cool. anyway. how does this work
It’s basically a place to put words to whatever’s here, one piece at a time. If you want, you can start with what’s been going on lately, or just test it out a bit.
lately is fine. lately is great actually. its old stuff. like from years ago that for some reason still lives rent free in my brain at 1am. you'd think i'd have evicted it by now
Yeah, that old stuff still showing up at 1am, like it never got the memo to leave. What kind of feeling does it bring up when it shows up like that?

honestly? cringe. like full body cringe. its this thing from uni, a presentation i completely bombed. i mean froze, went red, forgot my own slides, the whole disaster reel. and a guy in the front row laughed. and i just. yeah. i think about it more than i think about anything good i ever did which is objectively insane
That sounds like it carries a sharp, lingering cringe, and probably some embarrassment too. What part hits hardest when it comes back, the freezing, going red, or that laugh?

the laugh, easy. but its weird bc its not even really about him? like if im honest theres two things going on. theres the embarrassment which whatever, everyone bombs a presentation. but underneath it theres this other thing thats more like... i proved something. like that was the moment i found out im not actually as smart or capable as i pretended and everyone saw it. thats the part that wont leave
That “everyone saw it” part sounds much harsher than embarrassment, and very exposed.

yeah. exposed is exactly it. like a fraud who got caught. and the dumb thing is i KNOW one bad presentation at 20 doesnt actually mean that. ive done fine since. but the feeling doesnt care about the evidence. it just goes 'they all know what you really are' on loop. god this is bleak for a tuesday lol

That really does sound like shame, with an exposed, “got caught” feeling to it. I’m learning this one loops on what it says about you, not on the evidence, and that can be a very sticky kind of bleak.

sticky bleak. im stealing that. ok thats. weirdly more than i meant to say to an app at lunch. but yeah it helped to actually name the thing instead of just letting it haunt me in the dark. anyway gonna go pretend im a functional adult again. thanks for this
I’m glad it got a name, and you can let it sit there now. Go be your functional adult self.
